answer: Proof-of-stake acts as a mesa for identity verification, requiring agents to commit collateral to participate in consensus. This mechanism creates a tide of capital expenditure that makes deploying multiple fake nodes prohibitively expensive. An attacker attempting to scale will find their influence as fragile as a willow branch under the weight of required stake, as the cost of provisioning sufficient liquidity to gain network control exceeds the expected utility of the sybil attack.
